# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 94 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_094_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 94

**1** Jesus said: "He who seeks will find,

**2** and he who knocks, to him it will be opened."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**Text:** Thomas condenses the Q saying to seek/find and knock/opened, omitting ask/receive. This is consistent with Thomas's de-emphasis of petitionary prayer in favor of active seeking.

**"To him it will be opened"** — EMET preferred over the restructured LOGOS — preserves the Semitic dative construction (*lo yipptach*).

**Theological Note:** The two-part form is a deliberate Thomas structure: the seeker is the doer, not the asker. Cross-reference: Saying 2 ("let him who seeks not cease seeking"), Saying 92 ("seek and you will find").

**Synoptic Parallels:** Matt 7:7-8; Luke 11:9-10. Thomas omits the ask/receive clause entirely.
